subject: Application: Graduate Engineer, Traffic and Transport, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I am applying for the Graduate Engineer (under one year of experience) position in traffic and transport engineering listed on the onemilegrid careers page, which asks for applications to this address.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge. I am Melton based, hold a White Card, a driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for site, regional and FIFO work. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines.

The chance to prepare transport impact assessments and give design advice while reporting directly to a Director is what draws me to onemilegrid. My road work so far is geometry, Austroads guides and AS 1742.14 from my course; I have not yet used SIDRA or traffic modelling software, so that is where I would be learning.

Could we arrange a short conversation about the graduate role? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com

letter.subject: Application: Graduate Engineer, Traffic and Transport
paragraphs: I am applying for the Graduate Engineer position in traffic and transport engineering at onemilegrid. Preparing transport impact assessments and design advice for clients, Councils and the Department of Transport and Planning, with a Director close by, is the kind of start I am looking for.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019), and in February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at the Albright Institute of Business and Language. The course covered road geometry, pavement and stormwater drainage design in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, using Austroads road and pavement guides and AS 1742.14, along with options analysis, cost estimates and risk registers.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as project-in-charge on a community hall renovation and then as a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works. I kept clients updated on progress, coordinated with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers, and wrote site and progress reports. Before that study I spent two years in technical support explaining problems to customers in plain terms, which I think suits client liaison and report writing.

I live in Melton, hold an Australian driver's licence, my own transport and a White Card, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I have not yet used SIDRA or other traffic modelling software, and I would be keen to learn it on your projects.
Thank you for considering my application. My resume is attached and more of my work is at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio.

notes: Employers rotation, open web.
